irc.module.autocycle.name: Get op back when left alone
irc.module.autocycle.summary: If you are left alone in a channel without op, leaves and joins again to get it. Never in +i or keyed channels.
irc.module.autoop.name: Automatic op and voice
irc.module.autoop.summary: Gives op, halfop or voice to the people you choose when they join your channels (if you have op).
irc.module.away.name: Automatic away
irc.module.away.summary: Marks you away when you close all your clients and, when you come back, sums up what you missed.
irc.module.block_motd.name: Hide the MOTD
irc.module.block_motd.summary: Does not show the server's message of the day to your clients.
irc.module.cert.name: Client certificate (CertFP)
irc.module.cert.summary: Identifies you on the network with a certificate instead of a password. Enables SASL EXTERNAL.
irc.module.charset.name: Character encoding
irc.module.charset.summary: Accents show correctly even when a channel uses Latin-1, and you can write in Latin-1 where needed.
irc.module.crypt.name: Message encryption (FiSH)
irc.module.crypt.summary: Encrypts your messages in channels and private chats with shared keys, compatible with FiSH for mIRC, HexChat and irssi.
irc.module.ctcp.name: CTCP replies
irc.module.ctcp.summary: Always answers VERSION (by default with the xBNC version and its web site), answers PING and TIME when no client is connected and stops CTCP floods.
irc.module.dcc.name: DCC through xBNC
irc.module.dcc.summary: DCC file transfers and chats go through xBNC: the other person does not see your IP and they work even behind a router.
irc.module.detach.name: Detached channels
irc.module.detach.summary: Channels that keep recording everything but do not appear in your client. They come back if someone mentions you.
irc.module.events.name: Events in the history
irc.module.events.summary: Keeps joins, parts, kicks, nick changes, topics and modes next to the messages.
irc.module.flooddetach.name: Hide flooding channels
irc.module.flooddetach.summary: If a channel suddenly fills with messages, it is hidden for a while so your client does not freeze. It keeps recording.
irc.module.ignore.name: Ignore
irc.module.ignore.summary: Messages from people you ignore never reach any client or the history. On Undernet it uses SILENCE so they are not even sent.
irc.module.invite.name: Invite and unban
irc.module.invite.summary: If you cannot join a channel (+i, +k, +l or a ban), asks X or ChanServ to invite or unban you and joins again.
irc.module.keepnick.name: Keep nick
irc.module.keepnick.summary: If your nick is taken when connecting, xBNC takes it back as soon as it is free.
irc.module.kickrejoin.name: Rejoin after a kick
irc.module.kickrejoin.summary: Rejoins the channel if you are kicked. Stops trying if you are kicked more than 3 times in a minute.
irc.module.log.name: Log files
irc.module.log.summary: Writes every conversation to daily text files, in the classic IRC log format.
irc.module.route_replies.name: Replies to whoever asked
irc.module.route_replies.summary: Replies to WHOIS, WHO, LIST, NAMES or ban lists go only to the device that asked, not to all of them.
irc.module.schedule.name: Scheduled tasks
irc.module.schedule.summary: Commands at a fixed time or every so often, in your time zone.
irc.module.services.name: Services login
irc.module.services.summary: Logs you in to X (Undernet), NickServ, Q or AuthServ when connecting and hides your IP before joining channels.
irc.module.stickychan.name: Sticky channels
irc.module.stickychan.summary: Channels you cannot leave by mistake: xBNC blocks /part and rejoins if you leave.
irc.module.stripcontrols.name: Remove colours
irc.module.stripcontrols.summary: Removes colours, bold, underline and blinking from messages, also in the history.
irc.module.watch.name: Watch words
irc.module.watch.summary: Copies messages containing what you care about to the *watch conversation, even if you were not connected.
